name: hotnigerianjobs-mcp
description: Hot Nigerian Jobs (jobs): search. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Hot Nigerian Jobs RSS 2.0 feed (the latest ~600 postings, ~500 KB). query is not sent (the feed documents no search parameter) - filter the returned postings client-side; the feed answers its whole current list in one response, so ignore next_page (page 2 is the same list). title is '<Role> at <Employer>'. id is the posting link.
